events.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Update: 10 New Languages, One Climb!
events.summary: Hi climbers! Until today, the demo was in English only, which meant a lot of you were playing with menus and messages in a language that isn’t yours, and we really didn’t love that. So here’s some good news: from this update, the interface and subtitles are available in your own language, and we’re kicking things off with these ten:Deutsch (German)Español (Latinoamérica)Français (French)Italiano (Italian)Polski (Polish)Português (Brasil)Русский (Russian)日本語 (Japanese)简体中文 (Simplified Chinese)한국어

events.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Update: Chat, Softer Rescues & Better Stability
events.summary: Hey climbers! Our Next Fest Update is out!The big one is chat: you can now talk to the people on your wall. We also made rescues feel a lot nicer, reworked how long falls end, gave the altitude bar a memory, and fixed the controller navigation in the inventory and menus. Important: Please restart your Steam Client to download the update!Full notes below:Chat with other playersThe chat panel used to show only rescues, server announcements and inactivity warnings. events.title: Climb Night: 8pm CET Today! Come and Climb with Us!
events.summary: At 8 pm CET, we’re hosting our first Climb Night on Discord. You hop into a voice channel at discord.gg/scapethegame, and we join in too!All you need is the Scape Playtest already sitting in your Steam library. A mic is nice but not required; text chat works just as well.This is our first Climb Night, so it’s a bit of an experiment. Tell us afterwards what you’d want more of. We’re also working on exclusive items for the Climb Nights after this one, something you can only pick up by being there.

events.title: Scape Playtest is now LIVE! How to get in?
events.summary: Getting in is easyGo to the Scape store page and hit Request Access under “Join the Scape Playtest”. The gates are open, so you are in straight away: Scape Playtest shows up in your library like any other game, and you can install and climb. If you requested earlier, you are in too.
